propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is hardcoded for Anthropic with inline provider selection branches that prevent AWS Bedrock routing and third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoints
pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook enables runtime provider selection without string-based branching, with ModelProfile exposing per-vendor capability flags for output modes and caching
AWS Bedrock-hosted Claude lacks retry/timeout configuration in the current implementation despite LLMConfig fields for max_attempts and timeout_s being intended to apply both providers equally

signed verdict sidecars must record provider identity, endpoint host, and support tier to enable attestation consumers to distinguish first-class (Anthropic/Bedrock native) from best-effort (OpenAI-compatible gateway) verdicts
REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY must compose with REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER to route calls through OpenAI-compatible endpoints rather than raising LLMConfigError
Bedrock cache_read_tokens and message-level prompt caching must be measured on second identical calls to verify that BedrockModelSettings cache configuration propagates to boto3/botocore client
